|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Understand Art, Understand A Species]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the current Players Committee card image published 9 March 2026. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' ([[Understand Art, Understand A Species]]): Virtual Set 19 release; card image first published 10 August 2022<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/understandartunderstandaspecies.gif</code> as published 10 August 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/understandartunderstandaspecies.gif holotable commit 25528d7] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “USED: Target a character in battle.
